title: Change the conditions on a qualified supervisor certificate
summary: Learn how to change the conditions on your qualified supervisor certificate if your personal circumstances or qualifications have changed.
intro:
A qualified supervisor certificate allows you to supervise and carry out the building or trade work shown on your certificate, subject to any specified conditions.

If your circumstances change (such as your qualifications), and this affects the conditions under which your certificate has been issued, you'll need to change your details. You can do this at a Service NSW Centre.

Note: If the expiry date of your certificate is less than 6 weeks away you'll need to renew it before you can vary the classes.
who_can_apply: Your circumstances have changed (e.g., qualifications) and this affects the conditions under which your qualified supervisor certificate was issued.
what_you_need: The required PDF forms (e.g., Application Form - Individual – PDF, General Building Work – PDF, Specialist Work – PDF, Other Building Work and Trade Work – PDF)
Original or certified copies of qualifications or experience to validate the change of condition

how_to_steps.text: Visit a service centre with your documents and payment.
